import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface

OUT = "/Users/yuluo/Desktop/game/games_test/reverse-engineering/tiny-glade/evidence/toolchain/clutter/"
prog = currentProgram
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x1422d6ed0")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("absent")
monitor.checkCancelled()
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(prog)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor)
    if not res.decompileCompleted():
        raise RuntimeError(str(res.getErrorMessage()))
    c = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
finally:
    d.dispose()
open(OUT + "populate_decompiled_full.c", "w").write(c)
open(OUT + "populate_decompiled_marker", "w").write(str(len(c)))
print(json.dumps({"chars": len(c)}))
